subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental grouped-Claw v1 schema and read-only planner now, including its agent-name-based identity model, or require an immutable install identity before establishing the base contract?
rationale: The remaining issue is a durable product and ownership contract that affects downstream creation, update, removal, provenance, and host references; code review cannot safely choose that direction.

options.title: Sponsor the read-only v1 base
options.body: Accept the gated schema and planner as the experimental base, with immutable install identity explicitly deferred to the create/resume contract.

options.title: Require install identity first
options.body: Hold this PR until the v1 contract includes a stable install identifier independent of the mutable agent name.

options.title: Narrow or externalize the proposal
options.body: Keep grouped package experimentation outside core until the lifecycle ownership model is settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the read-only v1 base
recommendation.body: Accept the gated schema and planner as the experimental base, with immutable install identity explicitly deferred to the create/resume contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review identifies the unresolved host-neutral lifecycle and immutable-identity boundary directly.
